import asyncio
import json
from mcp import ClientSession
from mcp.client.streamable_http import streamablehttp_client
from mcp_helper import SERVERS

async def call_json(server_key, tool_name, args):
    url = SERVERS[server_key]
    async with streamablehttp_client(url) as (read, write, _):
        async with ClientSession(read, write) as session:
            await session.initialize()
            res = await session.call_tool(tool_name, args)
            texts = [c.text for c in res.content if hasattr(c, 'text')]
            return json.loads(texts[0]) if texts else None

async def main():
    # 1. All Confluence pages
    print("=== ALL CONFLUENCE PAGES ===")
    cursor = None
    while True:
        args = {"limit": 100}
        if cursor:
            args["cursor"] = cursor
        data = await call_json("confluence", "get_pages", args)
